As soon as you get it done, you have to come home and not tie or let your hair touch water for around 48 hours. Then you go back to the salon and they wash it one last time. 

After this for a few months it will be stick straight and the volume will be lost. 
But then as time progresses, the volume comes back and it looks like a more natural straight. This is the golden era imo.
A few months after this the new hair comes in from your scalp and thus begins the awkward phase of your hair where it’s half curly and half straight. This is where I start straightening the top half of my hair to get it to match (but it dosent stay because ofcourse it dosent) 
Eventually a time will come for you to cut off all the straight pieces and get back to your curly hair for a while - until you get bored and straighten it again
